nested_lists.name: addenda

fields.name: addendum_name

fields.name: addendum_type
fields.why: PC-6, FR-3 — a side-agreement addendum is an FR-3 signal

fields.name: is_attached
fields.why: PC-6 — referenced but missing is the finding

nested_lists.name: contingencies
nested_lists.shape_reason: 3-6 items; flat rows are trivially cheap

fields.name: is_waived
fields.why: PC-9 — a waived contingency has no deadline to miss

rejected.name: is_arms_length
rejected.reason: a judgment, not a fact — FR-2's job. Extract the SIGNALS (agents, disclosed relationship), not the conclusion

rejected.name: ipc_limit_exceeded
rejected.reason: a judgment — PC-4 computes it against a program cap the contract does not know

rejected.name: financing_type
rejected.reason: duplicates the 1003's loan_purpose; the contract's assumption is not authoritative

rejected.name: title_company_name
rejected.reason: reachable, but TI-1 uses the title commitment itself

encoding_variations: State-specific forms — a California RPA reads nothing like a Texas TREC form or a local realtor-board contract
Seller credits appear as 'seller concessions', 'seller-paid closing costs', 'seller contribution', or in an addendum
Contingencies may be checkboxes with day-counts ('17 days from acceptance') rather than dates
Personal property may be a checklist, a paragraph, or an addendum

options: return the raw phrase and let a derived producer compute
open_questions.recommendation: extract both — the computed date in value, the raw phrase in snippet

open_questions.q: Seller credit split between contract and addendum
open_questions.recommendation: sum, with each source in the snippet — PC-4 needs one number against a cap

open_questions.q: Contract property_type vs the 1003's — they can disagree and no rule compares them
open_questions.recommendation: capture both; flag the absent comparison as a candidate rule

notes: The shipping extractor has 6 fields, all with consumers — nothing to remove. This spec adds 26.

LP-407-1 confirmed seller credit, addenda, personal property and contingency dates are reachable ONLY via the free-form catch-all, which is discarded at the snapshot boundary. PC-4, PC-6, PC-8 and PC-9 are dead until these become typed-core. This spec is that fix.
